claim: Patchline ships an enterprise procurement kit (security, legal, SLA) backed by automated evidence. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the procurement claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make enterprise-procurement-kit-gate`.
